text: This report recommends that the name "Gershon Iskowitz Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane east of Tecumseth Street, extending southerly from Richmond Street West. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Gershon Iskowitz Lane" for an existing public lane east of Tecumseth Street, extending southerly from Richmond Street West.
